candidates.change_summary: Replace the `!paused()` check with `true` so it always reverts with 'Pausable: paused' regardless of state, changing the return value path.
Remove the onlyLRTAdmin modifier from updateLRTConfig, allowing any caller to change the LRTConfig address.
Replace the hasRole check in onlyLRTAdmin modifier with a check for MANAGER role instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
Replace the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in the hasRole check with a nonsense bytes32 value, making the role check always fail.
Delete the entire require/if check inside onlyLRTAdmin, so the modifier grants access to everyone.
Removed the assignment maxNodeDelegatorCount = 10, leaving it at its default value of 0.
Moved lrtConfig assignment before maxNodeDelegatorCount assignment, so maxNodeDelegatorCount remains uninitialized (0) if lrtConfig assignment reverts due to ILRTConfig interface division.

Changed the initializer modifier condition to revert on the second call, preventing re-initialization but breaking first-time initialization on contracts detected as contracts, so initialize never sets maxNodeDelegatorCount.
